title: manifest.json
description: A package's identity and inputs; plain JSON with no front matter. Nodes, macros, snippets, formats and deliverables are listed by their folders' index.json.

name.description: The package's name, for example example-nested-note or test/general.

derivedFrom.description: The name@version this package was copied from, or null if none.

title.description: The display title, or null to show the ref.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the package).

label.description: The display name of the input on the Create page; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the input's help text).

format.description: The input's type, which picks the widget: a format name or an inline schema.

required.description: Whether the user must supply it; an input that is not required reads null when left blank.

channel.description: The content channel, or null for any input.

inputs.description: The inputs keyed by id, in Create page order; {} when none.
